shieldBattery.mechanic: finite emergency Shield restoration; automatic research-AI discharge below 50 percent Shield only; finite charges

shieldBooster.mechanic: passive increase to maximum Shield Capacity

shieldHardener.mechanic: powered Shield DEF bonus; broad protection, strongest against Energy but not SPEN-specific

ablativeArmor.mechanic: one expendable outer layer that absorbs raw post-Shield damage before primary Armor; no tactical repair

energizedArmor.mechanic: powered Armor RES bonus; passive Armor remains functional when unpowered

crystallineArmor.mechanic: non-regenerative Crystalline Armor branch: additional Armor capacity plus RES; sacrifices tactical Armor regeneration
crystallineArmor.selectionRationale: CP159 late-TL headroom closure: RISE_A corrects TL9 decay without consuming the much larger defensive headroom demonstrated by RISE_B/C and flat-max candidates.

fieldStabilizer.mechanic: anti-SPEN Shield tuner: while active, subtract its rating from incoming SPEN before effective Shield DEF is calculated; cannot reduce SPEN below zero
fieldStabilizer.identity: specialist counter to high-SPEN attacks; unlike Shield Hardener it provides no benefit against SPEN 0 attacks
fieldStabilizer.selectionRationale: CP159 specialist sweep bracketed the response through complete SPEN nullification. FST_HIGH preserves strong niche value with diminishing-return headroom above it; 1 TP remains the provisional powered execution center pending final Reactor/TP equilibrium.

repairDroneBay.mechanic: adds one additional Damage Control action per Damage Control phase; crew and Drone actions must target different eligible repair targets in that phase; never a same-target reroll
repairDroneBay.attemptRules: Drone action uses the normal target-specific Damage Control success chance, the normal Damage Control per-attempt Tactical Power cost, and one Repair Kit per attempt; destroyed components remain non-field-repairable unless the underlying Damage Control rules change
repairDroneBay.repairKitRule: Repair Drone Bay carries one additional prepared Repair Kit load equal to the ship default prepared kit reserve at that TL; total prepared kits with one Bay are therefore 200 percent of the normal ship reserve.
repairDroneBay.selectionRationale: CP159 microstudy showed that the extra action is a parallelism upgrade rather than free healing: TP or kit scarcity naturally limits use. The +100 percent kit endpoint supplies the Drone with one complete additional repair load and is the cleanest KISS execution center.

kineticMagazine.mechanic: +25 Kinetic ammunition; duel outcome effectively nonbinding in CP158; value is endurance/logistics

missileMagazine.mechanic: +25 Missile Flights; duel outcome effectively nonbinding in CP158; value is endurance/logistics

powerClosure.apuStacking: Additive Operational TP; no arbitrary count limit.
